name: paperless-ngx
description_en: A community-supported supercharged document management system: scan, index and archive all your documents
readme_excerpt: Paperless-ngx Paperless-ngx is a document management system that transforms your physical documents into a searchable online archive so you can keep, well, less paper. Paperless-ngx is the official successor to the original Paperless & Paperless-ng projects and is designed to distribute the responsibility of advancing and supporting the project among a team of people.
